create_VAEEncoder: create a VAEEncoder module that downsamples input images into latent representations with configurable resolutions and attention types
create_VAEDecoder: create a VAEDecoder module that upsamples latent tensors back to image space with optional tanh output and grayscale support
build_ResnetBlock: build a ResnetBlock with group normalization, convolutions, dropout, and optional timestep embedding projection
create_AttnBlock: create a spatial self-attention block using query-key-value projections and softmax-weighted value aggregation
create_LinearAttention: create a linear attention module that computes attention via kernelized key-value context for O(n) complexity
